bread.name: Bread
bread.flavorText: Harder than I would like, but still reliable food for the road.

water.name: Water
water.description: Drinkable water in a simple container.
water.flavorText: No journey lasts long without water.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.description: A clean bandage for quick treatment.
bandage.flavorText: It is no doctor, but it can stop bleeding.

wood_log.name: Wood log
wood_log.description: A piece of dry wood fit for a fire.
wood_log.flavorText: Just ordinary wood until the weather turns cold.

artifact_hoe.name: Strange hoe
artifact_hoe.description: An old tool that feels out of place and strangely familiar.
artifact_hoe.flavorText: A strange bit of metal. When I got lost, it peeked out of the bushes near a spring, and suddenly I knew where I was. I am keeping it for luck.

hat.name: Cap
hat.flavorText: A practical piece for the outdoors, compact, light, and useful.

baseball_black_cap.name: Black baseball cap
baseball_black_cap.description: A very modern black baseball cap.
baseball_black_cap.flavorText: An elegant black cap, better suited for the city, but comfortable and stylish.

sport_cap.name: Sports cap
sport_cap.flavorText: I mostly wear it to the gym or when I exercise outside. Its best days are behind it.

shirt_modern_basic.name: Modern T-shirt
shirt_modern_basic.flavorText: A plain cotton T-shirt. I like it; it is light and wicks sweat quickly.

shirt_outdoor_warm.name: Warm outdoor shirt
shirt_outdoor_warm.flavorText: Quality field clothing, not some cheap piece from China. A proper outdoor shirt that keeps me warm in the cold.

hoodie_basic.name: Hoodie
hoodie_basic.flavorText: I love this cut. It is comfortable, and I am neither too hot nor too cold in it.

jacket_outdoor.name: Outdoor jacket
jacket_outdoor.flavorText: Essential outdoor gear outside of high summer. Waterproof, tough, and already proven in a snowstorm.

pants_outdoor.name: Outdoor trousers
pants_outdoor.flavorText: Ideal outdoor gear: durable, water resistant, and fairly light.

sneakers.name: Nike shoes
sneakers.flavorText: Great shoes for skating or the city. They are comfortable, I have walked hundreds of kilometers in them, and they still hold together.

boots_outdoor.name: Outdoor boots
boots_outdoor.flavorText: Quality field boots. I still call them new even though I bought them two years ago. They are light and do not make my feet ache.

shoes_hiking_light.name: Light hiking shoes
shoes_hiking_light.flavorText: Light sneakers, more for town than wilderness, but good enough for a short walk.

belt_leather_strong.name: Sturdy leather belt
belt_leather_strong.description: A strong belt for carrying gear.
belt_leather_strong.flavorText: Essential with a backpack outdoors. It gives me extra places to hang important things, so my canteen stays close at hand.

wood_stove.name: Twig stove
wood_stove.description: A welded stainless cutlery drainer and three tent pegs.
wood_stove.flavorText: A great invention by my friend Kaja: an old stainless drainer, three welded tent pegs, and suddenly it is useful outdoor kit.

gas_stove.name: Gas stove
gas_stove.description: A camping gas stove with a canister attached.
gas_stove.flavorText: A reliable heat source. Swap the canister, no smoke, no fire-starting fuss.

gas_can.name: Spare gas canister
gas_can.description: A spare canister for the gas stove.
gas_can.flavorText: A spare canister for the stove. I have refilled it from a gas bottle at home a few times, and it has not exploded yet, so hopefully it lasts.

flint_and_steel.name: Flint and steel
flint_and_steel.description: A useful outdoor tool for starting a fire.
flint_and_steel.flavorText: It takes skill, but striking a fire this way has charm. Most importantly, I need nothing else. Two pieces of flint are another league.

lighter.name: Lighter
lighter.description: A cheap ordinary lighter from a newsstand.
lighter.flavorText: Cheap, but good enough for a short camping trip in the woods. It still has gas.

military_scum.name: Quality mess kit
military_scum.description: A durable titanium cooking set for the outdoors.
military_scum.flavorText: A proper army-shop mess kit. It survives almost anything, does not burn food easily, and makes forest breakfasts better.

knife_bushcraft.name: Bushcraft knife
knife_bushcraft.flavorText: A proper man carries a knife. This is a quality piece of steel; if needed, it can split kindling or butter bread.

knife_small.name: Small knife
knife_small.flavorText: A small Swiss-style knife. Not the original, but enough for a short stay outdoors. I even use it for a manicure now and then.

pouch_small.name: Small pouch
pouch_small.flavorText: A small belt pouch. I keep important things close at hand, better than a waist bag, which I never wore anyway.

backpack_modern_large.name: Large backpack
backpack_modern_large.flavorText: Essential gear for multi-day trips. It is scuffed, but still in good shape and does not hurt my back after a full day of walking.

backpack_modern_medium.name: Medium backpack
backpack_modern_medium.flavorText: I take this one on shorter trips when I do not want to haul the main pack. It is lighter, though not as comfortable over longer routes.

backpack_modern_small.name: Small backpack
backpack_modern_small.description: A light small pack for personal belongings.
backpack_modern_small.flavorText: A small pack for a short stay in the wild. It holds the essentials, which is enough for one night outdoors.

water_bottle_metal.name: Metal canteen
water_bottle_metal.flavorText: A tough steel canteen for water. Another good investment I made.

water_bottle_plastic.name: Plastic water bottle
water_bottle_plastic.description: An ordinary shop-bought mineral water bottle.
water_bottle_plastic.flavorText: A lighter water option for the road when I do not feel like carrying the canteen.

water_filter_basic.name: Water filter
water_filter_basic.description: A basic filter for mildly dirty water.
water_filter_basic.flavorText: It filters dirt out of water, though not chemicals. I once drank water from the Sazava river. Never again.

tarp_basic.name: Tarp
tarp_basic.flavorText: A quality piece of waterproof fabric. Stretch it over the hammock and it can rain all night.

hammock_basic.name: Hammock
hammock_basic.description: Light sleeping gear above the ground.
hammock_basic.flavorText: Before I discovered hammocks, sleeping in the woods lacked something. Find two trees and I sleep like a king.

powerbank_basic.name: Power bank
powerbank_basic.flavorText: Basic survival gear in the wild without a charger, or when the power goes out at home.

solar_panel_folded.name: Solar panel
solar_panel_folded.flavorText: My power bank has died on me more than once. A pricier investment, but priceless without electricity.

smartphone_offline.name: Mobile phone
smartphone_offline.description: An offline phone without a usable network.
smartphone_offline.flavorText: Without transmitters that will not stand here for centuries, it is almost useless. Good thing I saved some things locally instead of keeping everything online.

hygiene_kit_basic.name: Hygiene kit
hygiene_kit_basic.flavorText: The hygiene kit I never head into the wild without: toothpaste, toothbrush, shampoo, and soap.

notebook_small.name: Notebook
notebook_small.flavorText: Even with a tablet at home, nothing beats plain paper. Now it is twice as useful, since I have nothing better and parchment will not be easy to buy.

pencil_basic.name: Pencil
pencil_basic.flavorText: A bit of graphite in wood, simple and now almost timeless. I do not know what I will do when it runs out, but I will manage.

food_ration_basic.name: Food ration
food_ration_basic.flavorText: A prepared day of food: bread, eggs, bacon, oat porridge, coffee, and tea. Give me a mess kit and fire and I am a cook.

MRE.name: Military daily ration
MRE.flavorText: If it is good enough for soldiers, why not for me? Beef with rice, and it even has a chemical heater.

shoes_skrpaly.name: Turnshoes
shoes_skrpaly.flavorText: Better than I expected. Real leather can take a lot, and if I care for them, they should last.

shirt_linen_basic.name: Linen shirt
shirt_linen_basic.description: A simple linen shirt common among ordinary people.
shirt_linen_basic.flavorText: Rougher than modern fabrics, but surprisingly pleasant. Functional underwear, just made with period means.

tunic_wool.name: Wool tunic
tunic_wool.description: A heavier tunic against the cold.
tunic_wool.flavorText: It scratches a bit, but keeps heat in. At least I will blend in and stop running around in a hoodie.

hose_wool.name: Wool hose
hose_wool.flavorText: Mornings would be colder without them. They are not as comfortable as modern trousers, but they are honest cloth.

hood_simple.name: Hood
hood_simple.description: A simple hood protecting the head and shoulders.
hood_simple.flavorText: Without a hood a person gets soaked quickly. Better than a tarp if I want to fit in here.

bread_dark.name: Dark bread
bread_dark.flavorText: Harder than I am used to, but edible. It tastes homemade, with an odd tang after a few days, but it is not moldy.

bread_wheat.name: Wheat bread
bread_wheat.description: Light bread made from wheat flour.
bread_wheat.flavorText: Fairly rare here, though back home it would be the cheapest bread around. This one has fuller flavor and keeps longer.

cheese_basic.name: Cheese
cheese_basic.flavorText: A strong taste, but it lasts. A bit like Gouda, only more aromatic. I can get used to it.

meat_dried.name: Dried meat
meat_dried.flavorText: Tough, but it keeps for weeks. I make mine with more spice; this is saltier, but I like it.

bacon_salted.name: Bacon
bacon_salted.flavorText: Winter would be much harder without bacon.

peas_dried.name: Dried peas
peas_dried.description: A basic ingredient for porridge or soup.
peas_dried.flavorText: Without peas, winter would be longer.

onion.name: Onion
onion.flavorText: Soup would be poor without onion.

meal_pea_porridge.name: Pea porridge
meal_pea_porridge.flavorText: Enough to keep a person working for half a day.

wooden_cup.name: Wooden cup
wooden_cup.flavorText: A small example of woodworking craft. Simple but functional, though I had to clean it thoroughly.

mug_ceramic.name: Ceramic mug
mug_ceramic.flavorText: Rough but sturdy. Every cottage has something like it. It is no porcelain, but better than a wooden cup.

bowl_wood.name: Wooden bowl
bowl_wood.flavorText: Ideal for porridge or soup, less ideal to wash. Sandpaper would be useful right now.

bowl_ceramic.name: Ceramic bowl
bowl_ceramic.description: A fired bowl suitable for porridge or soup.

spoon_wood.name: Wooden spoon
spoon_wood.description: A carved spoon for daily use.
spoon_wood.flavorText: The only cutlery in the Middle Ages, apart from a knife. Here it is mostly porridge, bread, and fingers instead of forks anyway.

waterskin_basic.name: Leather waterskin
waterskin_basic.description: A leather skin for carrying water.
waterskin_basic.flavorText: There is nothing better for carrying water here. I expected it to be dirtier, but it is fairly well kept.

hoe_basic.name: Hoe
hoe_basic.description: A simple tool for garden work.
hoe_basic.flavorText: Field work would be unthinkable without a hoe. Everything depends on hard manual labor.

sickle.name: Sickle
sickle.description: A curved tool for harvesting grain.
sickle.flavorText: Harvesting grain would be hard without a sickle. I would not want to spend all August doing this in the fields.

flail_thresher.name: Flail
flail_thresher.flavorText: The rhythm of the flail carries through the whole barn. It is not as easy to use as it looks.

axe_woodcutting.name: Axe
axe_woodcutting.description: An axe for splitting and felling wood.
axe_woodcutting.flavorText: Without an axe there is no firewood and no fire. It is not as different from a modern one as I expected.

rake_wooden.name: Wooden rake
rake_wooden.description: A simple rake for hay and leaves.
rake_wooden.flavorText: You can judge a good yard by its rake.

smithing_iron_rod_piece.name: Iron rod piece
smithing_iron_rod_piece.description: A short piece of square iron rod suitable for forging a nail.
smithing_iron_rod_piece.flavorText: Enough for one honest nail, if I do not burn it in the fire or ruin it on the anvil.

smithing_nail_workpiece.name: Unfinished nail
smithing_nail_workpiece.description: A cut and shaped nail workpiece before final cooling and inspection.
smithing_nail_workpiece.flavorText: It already looks like a nail, but Benes would not call it finished before checking it.

smithing_tongs.name: Smithing tongs
smithing_tongs.description: Long tongs for safely holding hot iron at the forge and anvil.
smithing_tongs.flavorText: Without these, the walk from the forge to the anvil would end in a burned hand, not a nail.

smithing_hammer.name: Smithing hammer
smithing_hammer.description: A short working hammer for controlled nail-forging blows.
smithing_hammer.flavorText: It does not look grand, but every poor blow will show in the iron.

smithing_nail_common.name: Forged nail
smithing_nail_common.description: A common hand-forged building nail with a square shank.
smithing_nail_common.flavorText: A small piece of iron, but without things like this no proper repair or building work gets started.

smithing_staple_common.name: Forged staple
smithing_staple_common.description: A heavy staple for joining wood and anchoring building parts.
smithing_staple_common.flavorText: An honest staple for gates, beams, and repairs meant to last longer than one winter.

smithing_hook_common.name: Work hook
smithing_hook_common.description: A useful forged hook with a punched eye for a workshop or household.
smithing_hook_common.flavorText: A simple hook will find a place on a forge wall, in a barn, or by the hearth.

smithing_horseshoe_common.name: Horseshoe
smithing_horseshoe_common.description: A hand-shaped horseshoe for a working horse.
smithing_horseshoe_common.flavorText: A properly shaped horseshoe is quiet work until it goes missing.

smithing_chisel_common.name: Carpenter's chisel
smithing_chisel_common.description: A forged chisel with a wooden handle for carpentry and joinery.
smithing_chisel_common.flavorText: Without a sharp chisel, even good wood quickly turns into poor work.

smithing_knife_common.name: Working knife
smithing_knife_common.description: A simple utility knife with a tang and ash handle.
smithing_knife_common.flavorText: It is not decorated, but it is exactly the kind of knife a person reaches for several times a day.

smithing_sickle_common.name: Forged sickle
smithing_sickle_common.description: A common working sickle for harvesting grain and herbs.
smithing_sickle_common.flavorText: A blade that can save hours of work if the smith did not burn it and shaped the edge well.

smithing_hoe_common.name: Forged field hoe
smithing_hoe_common.description: An ordinary working hoe; its shape recalls the main artifact, but it is entirely mundane.
smithing_hoe_common.flavorText: It does not glow or whisper, it just breaks soil honestly. That is enough by itself.

smithing_axe_common.name: Forged work axe
smithing_axe_common.description: A medieval working axe for forestry and carpentry.
smithing_axe_common.flavorText: A well-seated head and honest edge decide whether work goes smoothly or hurts.
